name: codex-with-cross-harness-parent
description: A codex child launched from a claude session: parent_harness_id names the parent's harness beside its session id.
grounding: A parent in another harness is named by (parent_harness_id, parent_harness_session_id); both are carried verbatim.
notes: Without x-tapes-parent-harness-id the parent is assumed to share the child's harness (claude-with-parent).
